requirements.text: The gate pass must be printed with a single click from the invoice data stored in Tally.
The pass must include the truck number automatically extracted from the invoice.
The pass must carry the e‑way bill number for consignments above ₹1,00,000.
The guard must be able to view the pass and the e‑way number without needing live connectivity.
During day mode the system must generate an invoice‑backed pass and allow the guard to open the gate immediately.
During night mode the system must allow a provisional chit pass to be created and matched to the invoice the next morning.
The system must not add any additional waiting time for the truck beyond the current process.
The system must record the date, lorry number, party, in time, out time, and chit number in a digital register.
The system must allow the guard to print the pass and the register entry in a single operation.
The system must be usable at the gate location where there is no reliable internet signal.

conflicts.about: Whether the pass must include the e‑way bill number and whether a penalty applies if omitted.
conflicts.resolution: The system will include the e‑way bill number on all passes above the threshold, preventing penalties.

constraints.text: The system must operate without live internet connectivity.
The system must not exceed the sanctioned budget of ₹90,000.

open_questions.text: What is the exact threshold for e‑way bill inclusion?
How will the system handle invoices generated after night chits?
What audit trail format is required for the digital register?
Will the system support multiple gate locations?
